name: Default Security Dashboard
description: Security practices dashboard with 10 common security practices - a mix of boolean (yes/no) and maturity-level practices.

embeddedSecurityExperts.name: Security Champions
embeddedSecurityExperts.description: Dedicated security champions or experts embedded within the team who advocate for security best practices, participate in code reviews, and serve as the first point of contact for security questions.

threatModeling.name: Threat Modeling
threatModeling.description: A systematic approach to identifying potential security threats and vulnerabilities in system architecture and design. Includes creating data flow diagrams, identifying trust boundaries, and documenting potential attack vectors.

secureCodeReview.name: Secure Code Review
secureCodeReview.description: Security-focused code reviews performed on all changes before merging to production. Reviews should check for common vulnerabilities, proper input validation, and secure error handling.

automatedSecurityTesting.name: Automated Security Testing
automatedSecurityTesting.description: Integration of automated security scanning tools (SAST, DAST, IAST) into CI/CD pipelines to detect vulnerabilities early in the development cycle.

dependencyScanning.name: Dependency Scanning
dependencyScanning.description: Automated scanning of third-party libraries and dependencies for known vulnerabilities (CVEs) and license compliance issues.

secretsManagement.name: Secrets Management
secretsManagement.description: Secure storage, distribution, and rotation of sensitive credentials including API keys, database passwords, certificates, and encryption keys.

securityRequirements.name: Security Requirements
securityRequirements.description: Security requirements are defined, documented, and tracked alongside functional requirements from project inception.

vulnerabilityManagement.name: Vulnerability Management
vulnerabilityManagement.description: A structured process for tracking, prioritizing, and remediating discovered vulnerabilities within defined SLAs based on severity.

incidentResponse.name: Incident Response
incidentResponse.description: A documented and tested incident response plan with clearly defined roles, responsibilities, communication channels, and escalation paths.

securityTesting.name: Penetration Testing
securityTesting.description: Regular penetration testing and security assessments performed by qualified internal teams or external specialists.

maturityScale.label: Initial
maturityScale.description: Ad-hoc, reactive approach with no formal process

maturityScale.label: Developing
maturityScale.description: Basic process defined but inconsistently applied
